seasonal_guidance.optimalWindow: Mid-July to mid-August, once approach snow firms up and before glacier crossings and the schrund open wide

June.reason: Deep snow still covers the long Ptarmigan-side approach and ridge camps, and lower pitches can hold snow and ice.

July.reason: Snow bridges still span Chickamin and Blue Glacier crevasses while the clean east-face granite dries; early July can still mean snow on the approach.

August.reason: Driest rock and most stable weather for a 4-5 day remote trip; by late August the bergschrund and crevasses open and need bypassing.

September.reason: Bare, crevassed glacier travel, a wider bergschrund, shorter days and the first fall storms make the multi-day commitment riskier.

October.reason: Fall storms bring snow and ice to the face, and the long glaciated approach and descent are exposed with little daylight.
